notes.title: Update - 1.2 HotFix Part1
notes.notes:
Hello !
It's time to make a big correction of my game.
With this update the loading is better.
The game runs 2 to 3 times better than before.

After : ~44 fps
Before : ~98 fps

The game is more beautiful than before !
If you have a problem you can ask me.
Enjoy ^^
